usage: xo edit [--dry-run] [--dir=<dir>] <op> <args...>

Semantic edits (core 10.4) through the checker's resolved symbols:
  rename <name> <new name>           function, method, constant, or type
  add-field <Struct> <name: Type = default>
  change-sig <fn> "(params) -> Result ! Err"
Every reference is rewritten at once, and the edit is rejected (nothing
written, exit 1) unless the program checks clean before and after it;
the JSON summary lists the files, the diagnostics, or the call sites
that blocked it, and with --dry-run a diff of the changes. Default dir: .
